name: process_id
description: Process identifier - no parallel processing support, batch only

name: process_end_time
description: Timestamp when the process completed - only set if job completed successfully

name: source_table
description: Source table for raw GCP export partitioned by _PARTITIONTIME

name: dest_table
description: Destination table for repartitioned and flattened GCP export

name: records_added
description: Number of records added during the process

name: max_source_date
description: Used as the bookmark for incremental loads to the base table

name: usage_dates_processed
description: Array of usage_start_time dates processed for downstream aggregates

name: max_dest_date
description: Maximum destination date - populated by the final step
